def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_row = next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0), None)
    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row+1:]
        return [[2 if a[r][c] and b[r][c] else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(min(len(a),len(b)))]
    if sep_col is not None:
        a=[row[:sep_col] for row in grid]; b=[row[sep_col+1:] for row in grid]
        n=min(len(a[0]),len(b[0]))
        return [[2 if a[r][c] and b[r][c] else 0 for c in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    return [[2 if v else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
